verdict.rationale: Goodwin's ERISA & Executive Compensation page says it advises on stock options, phantom equity, and appreciation rights, and mentions "UK incentives." Its employment page covers compensation plans, so core option-plan design is described on its own pages. Local schemes are thin: the UK appears only as a generic reference, and German and Indian schemes are not mentioned despite a Munich office. Missing for 10: UK EMI named explicitly, German VSOP/ESOP coverage, Indian ESOP coverage, any founder-facing equity plan guide or tool on Founders Workbench, and independent corroboration.
